manifesto.method.s1.title: The Soul
manifesto.method.s1.desc: Typography is not just letters. It is the spirit of the time, captured in vector form.
manifesto.method.s2.title: Artifacts
manifesto.method.s2.desc: We do not simply create files. We engineer digital heritage for the future web.
manifesto.method.s3.title: Visual Voice
manifesto.method.s3.desc: Volume is not determined by size, but by character. Silence can be the loudest sound.
manifesto.method.s4.title: Timeless
manifesto.method.s4.desc: Fashion changes. Trends fade. Geometry is eternal.
manifesto.impact.desc: We believe type is the purest form of design. It bridges the gap between raw utility and emotional expression. Every curve is a deliberate artistic choice.
manifesto.agency.desc: We engineer digital ecosystems. This archive is our contribution to the visual culture of the open web.
protocol.title: The Protocol
protocol.subtitle: Typography is art, but not just art. It is the structural system that holds human knowledge.
protocol.ready: You are now ready to operate the machinery.
module.kerning.theoryText: Kerning is the process of adjusting the spacing between characters in a proportional font, usually to achieve a visually pleasing result. In the combination "AV", the diagonal strokes create a large gap that must be tightened optically.
module.tracking.sampleText: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
module.tracking.headline: HEADLINE
module.tracking.captionDesc: Small text requires loose tracking to prevent characters from blurring together.
module.tracking.displayDesc: Large text requires tight tracking to maintain word cohesion.
module.weight.desc: "Typographic Color" refers not to hue, but to the density of black ink on the white page. Bold weights create dark spots; light weights create grey texture. Balance is achieved by distributing this mass intentionally.
module.alignment.sampleText: Typography is the art and technique of arranging type to make written language legible, readable, and appealing when displayed. The arrangement of type involves selecting typefaces, point sizes, line lengths, line-spacing (leading), and letter-spacing (tracking), and adjusting the space between pairs of letters (kerning).
module.alignment.leftDesc: FLUSH LEFT: The standard for western languages. The 'rag' (uneven edge) on the right creates a rhythmic, organic feel and aids reading flow.
module.alignment.centerDesc: CENTERED: Symmetrical and formal. Harder to read for long texts because the eye must find the start of each new line.
module.alignment.rightDesc: FLUSH RIGHT: Used for captions or marginalia. Creates a strong vertical axis on the right, but the left rag can be hard to track.
module.alignment.justifyDesc: JUSTIFIED: Formal and geometric. Creates a clean block, but risks 'rivers' of white space running through the text if not hyphenated correctly.
module.grid.text1: In typography, vertical rhythm is established by a consistent baseline grid. Every element must align to this invisible structure to create a sense of order and harmony.
module.grid.text2: When the grid is broken, the design feels chaotic. When it is respected, even complex layouts feel calm.
module.optical.desc: Round shapes must be slightly larger than flat shapes to appear optically equal in height. Without "overshoot", the circle would look smaller than the square.
module.anatomy.stemDesc: The main vertical stroke of a letterform.
module.anatomy.bowlDesc: The curved part of the character that encloses the circular or curved parts.
module.anatomy.legDesc: The lower, down sloping stroke of the R.
module.anatomy.counterDesc: The open space in a fully or partly closed area within a letter.
module.mix.bodyText: Each typeface has a voice. When we combine them, we create a conversation. The headline announces the intent; the body text delivers the information. The friction between them creates visual interest.
module.mix.pair2Desc: Classic Contrast. Serif Header + Sans Body.
module.mix.pair3Desc: Bold Statement. Condensed Sans + Readable Serif.
